about: Author-editable front-to-back placement of each paper, for the map's depth axis and the Newcomer lens. Edit a placement's tier or why, and change its standing to AUTHOR_CURATED once it reflects your judgment. Papers missing from this file are shown on a marked 'not yet placed' plane.

tiers.label: Start here
tiers.description: Opens from a problem a newcomer already recognizes; little prior vocabulary needed.

tiers.label: Core
tiers.description: The general theories and central architectures the corpus keeps returning to.

tiers.label: Going deeper
tiers.description: Mechanisms, methods, and architectures that assume the core vocabulary.

tiers.label: Specialist
tiers.description: Domain applications, technical companions, standards, and narrow variants.

standing_values.INTERFACE_DRAFT: Placed by the interface, awaiting author review.
standing_values.AUTHOR_CURATED: Placed or confirmed by the author.

method: Interface draft, 2026-10-25: each paper read from its title, the opening of its abstract, its profiles, and how many papers list it as related (generated cross-links). Reading-route stops were placed at Start here or Core. Every placement carries a one-line reason.
